description: This file defines TypeScript types, interfaces, and functions related to managing skills, including searching, loading, updating, installing, and handling skill details within a UI state management context. It communicates with external services via a client request interface and handles asynchronous operations for skill management features.

methods.description: Sets or deletes a skill message in the state.

methods.name: function getErrorMessage(err: unknown) { getErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts an unknown error object to a string message.

methods.name: export function setClawHubSearchQuery(state: SkillsState, query: string) { setClawHubSearchQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query and resets related search state variables.

methods.description: Loads the skills report from the external service if connected and not already loading.

methods.description: Updates the local edit value for a specific skill key.

methods.name: export async function updateSkillEnabled(state: SkillsState, skillKey: string, enabled: boolean)/ updateSkillEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a skill by requesting the external service.

methods.name: export async function saveSkillApiKey(state: SkillsState, skillKey: string) { saveSkillApiKey
methods.description: Saves the API key for a specific skill.

methods.name: export async function installSkill( installSkill
methods.description: Installs a skill given its key, name, and install ID.

methods.name: export async function searchClawHub(state: SkillsState, query: string) { searchClawHub
methods.description: Performs a search query on ClawHub for skills.

methods.name: export async function loadClawHubDetail(state: SkillsState, slug: string) { loadClawHubDetail
methods.description: Loads detailed information for a specific ClawHub skill.

methods.name: export function closeClawHubDetail(state: SkillsState) { closeClawHubDetail

methods.name: export async function installFromClawHub(state: SkillsState, slug: string) { installFromClawHub
methods.description: Installs a skill directly from ClawHub by its slug.
